Chapter 6766: Devour Your Clan

Chapter 6766: Devour Your Clan

The lord had another reminder of how frightening immortals were. He already knew about this but seeing them in action was a different story.

An emperor was an insect in comparison, let alone regular cultivators. He praised his luck and self-awareness because it could have ended terribly for him and his kingdom.

He also appreciated Phoenix Emperor’s message. Otherwise, he might have done the same thing as Emerald Emperor and offended the two immortals. After all, neither revealed any divinity. Li Qiye, in particular, had a mortal body no matter how he looked at it.

A maid crushed such a powerful emperor. Just who was she?

“An ancestor?” Many stole glances at her before turning away.

They then stared at Li Qiye, wondering about his identity.

“An overlord, maybe?” A king turned pale; his lips quivered as he spoke.

“Impossible, the only overlord in our world is behind Sky Zenith.” A regular ancestor whispered.

Did these two appear out of thin air? Everyone had numerous guesses in their mind.

“Who killed my disciple?!” A bestial aura suddenly engulfed the area.

The roar alone destroyed mountains and towering trees. Some beasts also ran away or dove into the water - a testament to the strength of the roarer.

“Ahh!” A few cultivators closest to the path exploded into blood.

“This is Tiger Ancestor from Sky Zenith...” A big shot became startled.

“Run!” The majority rushed away from the scene.

“Bam!” A colossal figure landed on a mountain nearby, crushing it entirely in domineering fashion.

Everyone looked back and saw a white tiger emanating waves of bestial aura. Beasts nearby kneeled as if they were seeing a king.

“Unbeatable...” Cultivators dropped to the ground, unable to move an inch.

Tiger Ancestor was the master of Emerald Emperor, one of the few ancient ancestors in this world. Only a few cultivators were stronger than him, Phoenix Emperor being one of them.

As the tiger looked around, everyone became terrified and felt as if they were being flayed. It revealed its snow-white teeth, ready to devour anything.

“This is more than just blood for blood, I will eradicate your clan. State your name so that I know where to send my tiger to devour them.” Tiger Ancestor threatened.

All listeners took him seriously except Li Qiye.

“So be it, no one related to you will survive.” Tiger Ancestor said murderously.

The world seemed to be frozen due to his glare. A layer of ice enveloped everything.

“Tiger Ancestor, this is not the place for you to be haughty.” Someone interjected.

“Ooo-” Next came the cry of a dragon and its incredible aura. All of Azure Plain could sense it.

The tiger’s aura was frightening enough and subdued numerous beasts. However, the dragon’s aura ignited an instinctive fear in all living beings.

Dragons were the crownless kings, the highest of existences.
